pages.text: After 30 more seconds of wear at sweat level 3 (configurable), you catch $(bold)foot fungus$() — it has $(bold)infinite duration$(): taking boots off or pouring sweat does NOT cure it.$(br2)While infected: -15% movement speed, sneezing on a timer, and while barefoot you shed green particles that nauseate nearby players ($(bold)wearing boots blocks the smell$()).

$(bold)The only cure$(): pour a bottle of $(bold)floral water$() into a water basin to turn it medicinal, then sit on a stool, take off your boots and soak until done (see "Washing & Curing").$(br2)Standing near an infected player can $(bold)infect you$() — and the infected can spread it further.
